notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only (curl with browser UA), no Playwright/Chrome needed - site is a server-rendered Shopify theme, all category pages and counts present in raw HTML. robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot/GPTBot/etc with full Disallow:/, but User-agent:* has Allow:/, so plain HTTP fetch is permitted; Claude-in-Chrome (tier c) was correctly avoided per that block and never needed. TREE: built from union of homepage mega-menu (header nav link1/link2 lists), sitemap_collections_1.xml (922 collection slugs), and each hub page's own sub-category circle strip. Soft Furnishing (mega-menu group) => Throws, Blankets, Cushions, Bed Linen, Rugs. Cushions itself has its own product-type sub-nav (Embellished/Embroidered/Set circle plus Quilted and Solid Colour found via sitemap with genuine unique SEO copy) so its own URL/qty was dropped per parent-URL rule and it was recorded as a grouping row over those 5 leaves. Table Linen (Dining mega-menu group) => Table Mats, Table Runners, Table Covers, Napkins (kept); Trivets and Napkin Rings dropped (not textile - hot pads / decorative rings). Floor Mats (doormats, coir + cotton per product alt text) and Towels and Apron are genuine populated category pages (floor-mats in nav; towels/apron sitemap-only, not in current mega-menu) recorded as standalone textile leaves. Storage: Organisers (Bath mega-menu group) => Jewellery Boxes & Organisers kept, Makeup Pouches dropped (personal-carrying pouch, not home storage, storage.md 6). Storage Jars (jars-canisters) and Storage Containers (fridge-storage-containers) are direct Kitchen mega-menu leaves. Kitchen Racks, Desk Organizers, Clothes Organiser, Bath Storage (bath-storage, distinct from the general Bath/bathroom-accessories hub) recorded as standalone storage leaves. Baskets (baskets) kept as Storage but LOW confidence/flagged - page title itself reads 'Storage & Decorative Baskets For Home' and sampled product alt text is a genuine mix of laundry/storage baskets and planter/fruit baskets with no sub-split available. QTY: every row's qty is the exact number from the page's own 'N Results found' (desktop) element, or 'id="ProductCount" data-productnum="N"' where the desktop span was absent (apron); no estimation or aggregation. EXCLUDED and why: makeup-pouches (bag/personal carrying, storage.md 6); decorative-boxes (site hierarchy places it under the decor 'Table Accents' menu next to Decorative Bowls/Trays, not under Organisers - decorative per storage.md 23-24); dustbins, bathroom-accessories, bathroom-sets, dispensers, beauty-accessories (bathroom accessories/fixtures, not storage or textile); wine-racks (bar accessory, not covered by storage rules); trivets, napkin-rings (not textile); bath-towels (0 products - dead/superseded duplicate of the live 'towels' collection); single-cushion-cover, cushion-cover-set, cushions-decor (sitemap-only pages carrying only the generic site-wide fallback og:description, i.e. unmaintained/orphaned duplicates, not distinct live subcategories); storage-containers, storage-jars, storage-organiser, venti-storage-container, vento-storage-container, gripso-storage-container, groovo-storage-container, storage-container-bowls, storage-container-salad-jars, storage-jars-with-rack, storage-jars-with-racks (redundant slug variants with bare placeholder titles like 'Storage Jars | Nestasia', overlapping the already-recorded jars-canisters/fridge-storage-containers/desk-organizers hubs - excluded to avoid duplicate/inflated records). No Furniture, Lighting, Kitchen & Dining tableware, Wall Decor, or plain Decorative Accessories nodes were included.
